title: Test a custom Hook with renderHook

slides.say: Hooks only run inside components. So how do you test a custom Hook by itself? Render hook.
Render hook calls your Hook inside a tiny test component. Result dot current holds what the Hook returned.
Update it inside act. Then read result dot current again. It always holds the latest committed value.
Need props? Pass initial props, and call rerender with new ones. A wrapper option can add providers too.

slides.text: If a Hook only serves one component, test that component instead.
slides.say: One tip. If a Hook is only used by one component, testing that component through the screen is usually the better test.
